text_block_list.text:
One day, I received a phone call from 
Reporter Otonashi.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"‘Sorry for calling so suddenly! I just 
had to tell you right away!’"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, in recognition of <chrname>'s 
performances this year—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I was chosen to be the Best Junior 
Umamusume!"

Reporter Otonashi continued to offer her 
polite congratulations afterwards as well.

I finished the call and was savoring the 
joy, thinking about how we'd keep doing 
our best together, when—

Trainer Kiryuin paid a visit, along with 
the gentle Umamusume under her charge, 
Happy Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Trainer <username>! I heard the news 
about your selection!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Your achievements this 
year have truly been nothing short of 
spectacular after all!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that your trainee is from the 
same class as me makes me feel so 
nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't sit still! Huge 
congratulations to you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it really made me feel like... 
next year, it'll definitely be our turn!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Let's both keep doing our best as 
classmates and as rivals!"

Afterward, <chrname> and I promised each other to 
do our best next year so that we wouldn't 
lose.
